name: remote-job-monitor
description: Durable local, SSH, Slurm, Apple-signing, and GitHub task lifecycles with a persistent Runner and event-driven dashboard.

interface.shortDescription: Default tracked route for SSH, remote jobs, and publishing.
interface.longDescription: RunBeacon protocol v5 routes non-interactive local, SSH, Slurm, Apple-signing, and GitHub work through one trace-bound lifecycle job. The optional protocol-v1 Go Runner keeps remote supervisors alive across SSH and daemon restarts, resumes sequenced events without replaying commands, and verifies process-group cancellation. Independent default SSH and GitHub profiles use OS-managed secrets. Policy-bound approvals and hash-chained audit records cover privileged, signing, release, and destructive work. The single-task dashboard uses long polling, pauses while hidden, and shows durability, connection, recovery, progress, approval, cancellation, and bounded output without repeated model turns.
defaultPrompt: Run this command on my default SSH server through RunBeacon, show the live dashboard, and continue when it finishes.
Save this SSH server IP, username, and password in the OS credential manager and make it my default.
Push my staged commit and monitor GitHub Actions in the dashboard.
